source-review.json.scope: Finite review of the AA equal-T MTP Model transaction, generation helpers, committed-token rebuild and CLI wave driver. This is not a build, native-runtime, numerical-quality or throughput result.

checked.topic: Actual old draft frame authority and per-member geometry
facts: The shared old layout is constructed from every member's real frontier/page list and arena.reframe receives the corresponding existing key/value PagedArenaRead owners. Numeric page IDs alone do not grant read permission.
Old carry/prior and catch-up inputs are bound per member; positions are request-major old.frontier+i. The common row count follows the exact selected role/lag.

Draft tail reuse requires the original base identity, exact page and initialized frontier, plus reserve_rows on both original capabilities. Failed reservation rolls back already-reserved tails; the ordinary COW path remains available. Containers needed for moves are reserved before capability transfer.

Participant, ledger uniqueness, original role/base/input and terminal completion checks precede selection. Selection is per member; every target/draft append is taken and made ready before publication.

Common draft ready frames are projected back through each member's actual draft layout. Tail capabilities are mapped by physical page to the corresponding member and checked against its frontier. Rejected target suffix capability is discarded rather than rewound.

All selected recurrent/hidden exports, frame projections, metadata checks and selective unbind complete before all member heads are swapped under the original serialized producer contract. No partial-head observation is introduced by this loop.

Every reserved ledger record is marked committed only after every head swap; those scalar writes cannot allocate. The endpoint is then recorded via stable output ledger storage after detach, before diagnostic IO can throw.

Accept2 records the actual consumed pending and natural draft; reject/Single records only the actual consumed pending. Prompt records retain their exact teacher-forced chunk owner. Successor emitted IDs are not misused as this step's consumed token tape.

finish_mtp_rounds checks each retired member.first_input against its explicit expected_pending. This separates already-returned engine policy from the newly recomputed head prediction without overwriting head.next_id.
Preallocated generated/round storage and two-ID emitted pools let observe_mtp_commits consume all committed witnesses even if later diagnostic IO throws. The model transaction remains authoritative.

checked.topic: General cache rebuild versus strict replay
facts: Rebuild prevalidates a continuous bounded committed input tape and legal accepted1/2 boundaries before executing. It reuses the original R1 Prefill/Single graph chain and normalizes the draft to lag0; it does not force old proposals, resample prior outputs or claim old B2 numerical identity.

The old resident head must actually retire/drop before a new rebuild head can enter N. Returned pending remains the request's historical CPU output; fresh rebuild predictions are retained in the head and any differences are reported.
Strict role/decision replay is separate and rejects non-R1 source geometry and imported prompt history with unknown original geometry (requests=0). It is not the universal cache-recovery contract.

checked.topic: Real wave batching, input lifetime and bounded admission
facts: Every active request supplies at most one call per wave. Calls are grouped only by equal kind, role and actual rows, bounded by active_sequences, without padding. Every lookup/admission precedes every checkpoint publication in that wave.

PreparedMtpCall::ids returns its own pending scalar after bucket copying. Prompt spans remain owned by per-turn warm_inputs and ledger input_owner. A request is not advanced twice before its original wave call is used to publish the prompt boundary.

Admission counts distinct selected base heads once and treats directory aliases/unselected resident requests as external owners. It evicts only directory entries or truly idle requests; a generating request is protected. A smaller actual R may be chosen when the committed-version bound prevents the larger bucket.

Finite cold families include actual possible prompt/suffix roles, compatible request widths, generation roles and R1 rebuild chunks. Plans are installed before execution carriers; no provider-specific executor or host draft-to-target handoff is introduced.

Physical graph calls and step time are counted once per executed bucket. Per-session graph participation and interleaved latency remain separate report fields. Restore work is separately included in actual graph/row/time totals.

limitations: This review found no blocking source defect in the named frozen files. It does not replace the root's strict compilation, original R1 regressions, actual R2 cancellation/retry, precision observations, CLI ledgers or performance measurements.

Batched and R1 dense/quantized geometry may produce different floating-point predictions. Normal cache rebuild deliberately records such differences; no bytewise cross-geometry or general model-quality threshold is signed here.

Budget reasoning is for the serialized consumer and its explicit session/directory owners, not an arbitrary external SnapshotRef graph. Real library permission, candidate admission and retirement gates remain authoritative.

The helper's independent index check covers finite synthetic request/row indices only; it is not a device/model-math proof. No new tests, builds, GPU work or performance experiments were run by this review.

probe.external_sampling_policy: explicit legal non-argmax token published by this probe, not a natural-greedy disagreement
probe.scope: Real R2 round with different histories, per-member quota2/1 and fresh natural proposals. R1-versus-R2 natural metrics are diagnostic and may have different accepted inputs or extents; no cross-B byte/ID or quality assertion. Canonical same-R1 teacher-forced committed-token rebuild alone has a byte oracle. Rebuild drops original GPU owners, normalizes draft lag0, emits no client output and consumes historical pending once before new user input. One real blocked cancellation uses original Graph/Completion/permissions; no device reads inside gate.

external_sampling.label: Explicit non-argmax emitted token policy, not natural numerical divergence

limits: R1 versus R2 natural proposals/accepted inputs may differ; same vector extent does not make those computations identical. No cross-B byte/ID or model-quality tolerance is asserted.
Canonical same-chunk R1 teacherforced rebuild alone has a byteexact oracle. Rebuilding a discarded B2 head is normal token recomputation, not exact old-state import.

Equal actual payloads explicitly reuse canonical baseline raw paths; native complete-array equality/oldhead checks are corroborated by exact compiled source and successful runtime assertions, not a second independently retained actual payload.
Gate/retirement/unchanged oldheads and absence of premature publication are native source/runtime assertions; offline logs cannot reconstruct all permission events.
Only this finite14Graph scene was checked. No performance, MTP concurrent multi-Invocation execution, other backend/quantization or whole-model quality claim.

findings: One shared335 Model, original ordinary Graph/Queue/Completion and14-bank append transaction remain authoritative. No new executor, native provider path or GPU history shadow was added.

MTP graph helper has explicit requests/sequence_rows/packed_rows geometry and shared dimension identities. Packed request-major rows retain independent RoPE, per-request pending/draft concatenation and warm-input shifts. Existing target T2 Conv/GDN row boundaries supply each member selection.

Actual finite CLI waves group by compatible real T, role and draft lag without padding, and respect N committed versions and state-byte budgets. Wave prefix lookups occur before new checkpoint publication. One actual bucket counts one physical Graph; each Session records its own participation.

Each member derives its natural draft/target result and acceptance independently. Whole-batch expected-base validation precedes all no-throw head swaps; preallocated per-member commit witnesses become authoritative before trace/report IO. Cancelling any member cancels the original entire episode and retains resources until actual retirement.

Normal cache recovery rebuilds original already-consumed input chunks, never resamples old generation. Accept2 consumes old pending plus old accepted draft, not bonus output. The original immutable host inputs and owned fixed-size accepted-input witnesses are retained; old GPU heads are truly retired under pressure.

Rebuild uses original Graph teacher-forced Single/Prefill operations, normalizes draft to target prefix/lag0 and publishes only after complete success. The new head keeps its actual fresh prediction; already-issued unconsumed pending remains a separate engine fact. Strict original-role R1 replay remains diagnostic-only and rejects unknown/R>1 provenance.

The14-Graph batch probe exercised natural per-member accepted lengths[2,1], separate projected frames/states and carry row selection. Blocking the actual CUDA queue retained versions2->4->2 through cancel, dropped Completion, native retirement and original R2-slot retry; final versions0.

Eight54-component probe images yield432 vector records and274 unique raw payloads. Cross-B comparisons have108 finite metrics,104 byte-equal and4 differing draft K/V. Same-chunk canonical teacher-forced rebuild has54 byte-equal components;17 target/17 draft rows normalize one lag row.

The natural probe rebuild happened to predict the same pending74455 and does not prove a natural mismatch. A separate explicit sampling-policy case consumes legal published248045 despite greedy74455, without overwriting head prediction. Actual R2 pressure CLI independently records one fresh-next decision change during normal rebuild.

Ten CLI cases cover R1/R2 resident and pressure, prefix miss and full hit, original flat MTP/ordinary entries and a focused equal-length warm pair. Main3-session/2-turn runs have26 outputs and89 logical inputs=86 user+3 pending. R1resident uses19 Graph, R1N1 uses29=19+10 rebuild; R2resident uses17 Graph/20 participations; R2N2 uses26=16 new+10 rebuild,64target/64draft replay rows and one normalized lag.

Four equal quota1 requests execute one real B2 prefill, then two complete prefix hits with zero Graph/no fabricated tensor payload,30 reused tokens and one remaining prefix-owned version within N2. Focused warm R2 actually runs role7 targetT2/draftT3 per member.

CLI host review validates308 finite raw payloads,108 scoped byte-equal pairs and84 equal-input/history/role cross-geometry metrics. Six work mismatches are explicitly excluded from numerical comparisons.2515 independent scalar/work-accounting checks pass. Eight malformed/capacity inputs reject before weight loading.

Cross-R output divergence is retained: mainA differs at zero-index5/R1=271,R2=198; warmB differs at zero-index4/R1=198,R2=271. At the main deciding call input/pending/draft/role/position match, but prior GPU state is not proved equal; the pressure deciding call is itself R1, so the cause cannot be attributed solely to current B2.

Global P/D remain disjoint token-visible wall intervals and include recovery. Per-Session participation latency overlaps and cannot be summed as throughput. All11 native model processes are trace diagnostics; no new throughput, physical-memory or full quality window was run.
limitations: These finite CUDA BF16 Qwen checks do not establish whole-model quality, all selected model/quant routes, other native backends, concurrent multi-Invocation serving or general batch-size invariance.

Byte equality is asserted only for original same-partition R1/ordinary regressions, identical real R2 prefix-miss partitions and the canonical teacher-forced rebuild. No invented cross-B tolerance or forced historical proposal is used.

Cross-B numeric and continuation differences remain unresolved. Different accepted candidate/history/role comparisons are not treated as equal work; equal input metadata alone does not establish equal prior tensor state.

Probe actual full-array equality/oldhead/permission assertions are tied to frozen compiled source and successful native execution; canonical raw aliases are not represented as independently retained second payloads.

No new speed or physical-memory comparison. The previous complete four-metric current-work table remains authoritative; fewer Graph calls with different natural acceptance/work are not a speed claim.
